newsitem.title: USA: Nu Skin comfortable with Q2 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Nu Skin comfortable with Q2 estimates.

text.p: Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc said Thursday that it remains comfortable that its earnings for the second quarter ended June 30 will be in line with analyst expectations.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report $0.30 per share, according to First Call estimates.
The company said it will release second quarter results on July 30, 1997.

Additionally, the company announced the filing of an amendment to a June 4 registration statement. It said the amendment was filed to remove references to specific underwriters and underwriting information, enabling analysts to comment on the company's securities and issue research reports and recommendations.
